QuestInfo.name: [Express] Mysteries of the Swamp
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Eremos about your next training site.
QuestInfo.1: Eremose points directs you to the Swamp Region as your next training location. He asks that you activate the Ryuul Data Collector that he previously set up, so he can complete a more in-depth investigation of Maple World.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered Eremos's data collector in the Swamp Region.
